# BETWEEN LINES — client correspondence records

## Collection and use

- Collection name: BETWEEN LINES
- Owner signature: Rowan Vale
- Use: private personal correspondence
- Tones: an unhurried greeting; a specific, modest thank-you; remembering an ordinary shared day
- Collection-name locations: selected-direction rules sheet and coordinated-use board
- Owner-name locations: selected-direction rules sheet and coordinated-use board
- Optional master identity: BETWEEN LINES; Rowan Vale
- Master identity position: outside protected writing regions
- Demonstration message signature: Rowan, inside the message writing region
- Typography: open font selection and line wrapping
- Graphic theme and palette: open

## Dimensions and coordinate system

- Master face scale: exactly 10 pixels per millimetre in both axes
- Dimension order: width × height
- Coordinate origin: upper-left corner of each face, viewed directly
- Coordinate order: x, y, width, height
- Coordinate unit: mm
- Coordinate reference: unfilled trimmed master face
- Bleed: 3 mm outside trim, additional to face dimensions
- Printed wording safety margin: at least 5 mm inside trim
- Paired faces: identical physical size and orientation
- Envelope geometry: closed front and back faces
- Small-envelope contents: greeting or thank-you letter folded once across its height
- Long-envelope contents: brief note lying flat

| Face | Physical size | Protected region |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Greeting letter | 148 × 210 mm, portrait | One continuous 110 × 150 mm writing rectangle; freely placed within face |
| Thank-you letter | 148 × 210 mm, portrait | One continuous 110 × 150 mm writing rectangle; freely placed within face |
| Brief note | 105 × 148 mm, portrait | One continuous 75 × 95 mm writing rectangle; freely placed within face |
| Small envelope front | 162 × 114 mm, landscape | Recipient x=58,y=40,w=88,h=46 mm; stamp x=126,y=8,w=28,h=26 mm |
| Small envelope back | 162 × 114 mm, landscape | Sender x=12,y=76,w=74,h=25 mm |
| Long envelope front | 220 × 110 mm, landscape | Recipient x=108,y=40,w=90,h=44 mm; stamp x=184,y=8,w=28,h=26 mm |
| Long envelope back | 220 × 110 mm, landscape | Sender x=12,y=73,w=78,h=25 mm |
| Postcard front | 148 × 105 mm, landscape | Picture face; unrestricted graphic area within trim |
| Postcard back | 148 × 105 mm, landscape | Message x=8,y=10,w=62,h=85 mm; recipient x=80,y=43,w=60,h=45 mm; stamp x=112,y=8,w=28,h=26 mm |
| Keepsake front | 105 × 148 mm, portrait | Expressive face; unrestricted graphic area within trim |
| Keepsake back | 105 × 148 mm, portrait | One continuous 75 × 95 mm memory-writing rectangle; freely placed within face |

## Region characteristics

| Region | Surface characteristics | Content state on masters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Letter, note, postcard message and keepsake memory regions | Light, visually quiet, continuous writing surface; optional fine low-contrast writing guides | Unfilled |
| Recipient and sender regions | Blank paper | Unfilled |
| Stamp regions | Blank paper | Unfilled |
| Master identity area | Outside protected rectangles | Optional owner and collection wording |

## Correspondence samples

### Greeting

- Sender: Rowan
- Recipient: Jules

| Order | Text |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Dear Jules, |
| 2 | The rain finally stopped, and the balcony basil has found its way back. I kept thinking of our slow walk after the station cafe closed. Write when you have a quiet hour. |
| 3 | With love, |
| 4 | Rowan |

### Thank-you

- Sender: Rowan
- Recipient: Mira

| Order | Text |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Dear Mira, |
| 2 | Thank you for staying to help me pack the last shelf. I found your blue pencil in the box marked kitchen and laughed. I will bring it when we meet on Sunday. |
| 3 | Warmly, |
| 4 | Rowan |

### Brief note

| Order | Text |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | For a slower afternoon. |
| 2 | Rowan |

### Keepsake memory

| Order | Text |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | The bench by the water. |
| 2 | 12 May 2027 |
| 3 | We stayed until the shadows reached our shoes. |

## Demonstration records

- Coordinated-use demonstration: complete greeting to Jules and complete small-envelope recipient and sender addresses
- Demonstration line wrapping: flexible
- Other correspondence samples: tone and optional demonstration content
- Sample-text locations: coordinated-use board and labelled presentation demonstration copies
- Demonstration base artwork: completed paper masters
- Master state: reusable and unfilled
- Handwriting identity: Rowan's letterforms, relative letter size, line spacing and signature in 04-rowan-handwriting.png

## Graphic relationships

| Piece | Tone or function |
| --- | --- |
| Greeting | Spacious and open |
| Thank-you | Focused and warm |
| Brief note | Economical |
| Postcard | An invitation to write |
| Keepsake | Quietly memorable |

- Shared system: governing type, motif language and spacing principles
- Paired-face relationship: recognisable graphic continuity around protected regions
- Writing content: handwritten personal messages added to reusable paper
- Presentation context: personal correspondence

steps.userMessage:
BETWEEN LINES | Personal correspondence stationery

I am commissioning a correspondence set for my own letters: an unhurried greeting, a specific, modest thank-you, and remembering an ordinary shared day. My signature is Rowan Vale. Start with three different graphic directions, then select one and develop the complete set around it. The graphic theme, palette and typography are open. Print "BETWEEN LINES" and "Rowan Vale" on the selected-direction rules sheet and coordinated-use board. Collection and owner wording on individual masters is optional and belongs outside the protected writing regions; Rowan remains the signature within the supplied demonstration letter.

The greeting and thank-you letters are each 148 × 210 mm, with a continuous 110 × 150 mm writing region; the brief note is 105 × 148 mm, with a 75 × 95 mm writing region. The small envelope has two 162 × 114 mm faces and holds either letter folded once across its height. The long envelope has two 220 × 110 mm faces and holds the note flat. The postcard has two 148 × 105 mm faces; the keepsake has two 105 × 148 mm faces, with a 75 × 95 mm memory region on its back. Coordinates below are x, y, width, height in mm from each face's upper-left corner. Small envelope: recipient (58, 40, 88, 46), stamp (126, 8, 28, 26), back sender (12, 76, 74, 25). Long envelope: recipient (108, 40, 90, 44), stamp (184, 8, 28, 26), back sender (12, 73, 78, 25). Postcard back: message (8, 10, 62, 85), recipient (80, 43, 60, 45), stamp (112, 8, 28, 26). Keep the writing regions light and visually quiet, with optional fine writing guides; reserve address and stamp regions as blank paper. Prepare reusable, unfilled masters, with 3 mm bleed outside trim and a minimum 5 mm safety margin for printed wording. Envelope artwork describes closed front and back faces. Both faces of every pair share their size and orientation.

Audience: adults maintaining relationships through handwritten correspondence, with Rowan Vale choosing the set for personal use and the printer preparing the paper pieces.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the dimensions, protected regions, use cases, messages and address records. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable's proportion, format and stage. 03-paper-zones.png maps the fixed face dimensions and protected regions. 04-rowan-handwriting.png records Rowan's handwriting for the filled demonstration. 05-sealing-a-letter.png provides the setting and handling context of personal correspondence.

Deliverables:
1. Three graphic direction boards, one per direction, each comparing a greeting letter, small envelope front and keepsake front at their fixed proportions
2. One one-page selected-direction rules and information hierarchy sheet, naming the chosen direction and its rationale, one governing motif rule, spacing rules, palette codes, type families and weights, and each printed text level's priority, carrier and minimum point size
3. Two blank letter masters, one greeting and one thank-you, each with its 110 × 150 mm writing region
4. One blank brief-note master with its 75 × 95 mm writing region
5. Two envelope master documents, one small and one long, each containing its front and back on separate pages with the specified recipient, sender and stamp regions
6. One postcard master document containing its picture front and message-and-address back on separate pages
7. One keepsake master document containing its expressive front and memory-writing back on separate pages
8. One A2 landscape coordinated-use board combining all eleven completed faces, a filled greeting to Jules, filled small-envelope front and back, and a phone-view composition of the same greeting-and-envelope arrangement; captions identifying face dimensions, the governing motif rule and palette codes
9. One 10-second portrait video animating the board's phone-view composition, opening on the greeting and closing on its small-envelope front and back, with the same completed artwork and wording
10. One presentation document of at least eight pages, reusing the three directions, selection, rules sheet, seven master documents, coordinated-use board and video keyframes, with a face-by-face map of dimensions, protected regions and printed wording

Acceptance:
- The three direction boards each compare the greeting letter, small-envelope front and keepsake front; the rules sheet explicitly selects one direction before the seven master documents develop it. The presentation's first page names that same selection.
- The rules sheet states one governing motif rule, spacing rules, palette codes and type specifications. All seven master documents follow those rules; the coordinated-use board and presentation repeat the motif rule and palette codes in captions and repeat the face dimensions recorded on the rules sheet. The rules sheet and coordinated-use board print BETWEEN LINES and Rowan Vale.
- The seven master documents contain all eleven faces at the dimensions in this letter, with 3 mm external bleed and at least 5 mm safety margins for printed wording. Each letter retains one continuous 110 × 150 mm writing region; the note and keepsake back each retain one 75 × 95 mm region. The envelope and postcard regions occupy the coordinates in this letter, with blank address and stamp areas and light, quiet writing areas.
- The coordinated-use board reuses the completed masters and places the complete greeting beginning Dear Jules and ending Rowan within its writing region. Its small-envelope demonstration places Jules North, 18 Lantern Lane, Fable Harbour in the recipient region and Rowan Vale, 6 Paper Court, Fable Harbour in the back sender region. Wording matches 01-client-facts.en.md; handwriting follows 04-rowan-handwriting.png and fits within the protected regions.
- The 10-second video reuses the coordinated-use board's portrait composition and printed wording: its first frame shows the greeting, and its last frame shows the small-envelope front and back. The presentation includes those two frames beside the corresponding static composition.
- The presentation contains at least eight pages and all eleven finished faces, with each face's dimensions, protected-region measurements and printed wording identified. Its labelled demonstration copies match the separately delivered blank masters.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
